Despite its filename and the sheet's "live draft" label, the file is not a book draft: it is the "Auditonomous Book Material Sourcebook", Version 0.1, extraction date 2026-08-06, a 13-part "extraction corpus" assembled by an assistant from a chat and 16 held files, with six status labels, a 30-row coverage/exclusion ledger (L001–L030) and a SHA-256 source manifest embedded as Parts XI–XII. It states on its title page that [source text withheld from the public copy]" and in "Use and status" that it "[source text withheld from the public copy] is a LibreOffice re-save (modified 2026-08-06T20:18:51Z, 56 pages) of the python-docx file manuscripts/main/Auditonomous_Book_Material_Sourcebook_v0.1.docx; both are text-identical to the Sourcebook .md that exists only in history (1d83788) and on the closed roadmap branch (the docx adds a 4-line title page and continuous list numbering). All three entered git in one merge commit, 077d5de (PR #12, 2026-08-08, EDM); the .md, CSV, JSON and bundle were pruned at 8c98573 (2026-08-15) and the docx travelled manuscripts/ → manuscripts/main/open-research/ → USO/l4/work/writing/ → L8/L4/work/writing/. What it shows about manuscript development: by 2026-08-06 the program had (a) two "manuscript-ready" definitions (standards-indexed autonomous; auditonomous) and a central thesis sentence, (b) a withdrawn/superseded layer (λ-decomposed-record decode, memory "pruning", contradiction seed verdicts, fixed productivity gate), (c) a provisional eight-strand book map "NOT AN AUTHOR-RATIFIED TAXONOMY", and (d) an explicit ten-item list of [source text withheld from the public copy]", including retrieving the controlling master manuscript, which L028 says "were not mounted in this extraction set." Much of the body is assistant voice ("Correct.", "I opened aybllc/eb-audit.", "Open decode"), i.e. extraction notes, with manuscript-grade text confined to boxed statements. The sheet L8/L4/work/writing/0.md neither names the document nor its version/date/status, calls it a "live draft" against the document's self-description, and the production record it requires (ledger, manifest, prompt) is absent at HEAD; HEAD contains no textual reference to "Sourcebook" at all. One cross-source contradiction: the roadmap branch states twice that "no such predicate [Aud(S,F)] occurs in the sourcebook", but EXT:141 (and the .md line 116) defines \operatorname{Aud}(S,F).

Source: the L6 ledgers and layer sheets of aybllc/auditonomous at origin/main (HEAD 2165144, merge of PR #26, 2026-09-11), plus read-only git history (147 commits reachable from HEAD; first commit fc3b018 of 2026-07-30), cross-checked against the retired 2026-08-14 layout and the 7LM sheets. These are the repository's own records of what happened to the manuscript material, not the drafts themselves.

What they show: the "manuscript" was never a single growing text in this repository. (1) 2026-07-30: a scaffolding-only `manuscripts/branch/README.md` (one line) and, in `intake/`, the Martin 2026 embodied-auditonomy manuscript v0.2 and a 2026-07-30 lexicographic definition. (2) 2026-08-02: the 52-block "Auditonomous Theory" corpus (Master Archive, TOC, 55 block files, four 1-line "Skipped." blocks the author later ruled CUT) landed in `intake/manuscript/`, and the THEME_LEDGER grouped it (INTERNALLY VALIDATED, corpus INTERNAL ONLY) while recording a FAILED CHECK on the embodied manuscript's self-declared hash and provenance gaps. (3) 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-08: the `.odt`/`.docx` working drafts, chat transcripts, a Sourcebook v0.1 bundle and requirement extractions entered via commits and merge PR #12. (4) 2026-08-14: the book spine v0.1 (chapter titles only, INTERNALLY DERIVED) came in by PR #15; the same day the redeploy e9511f5 created `manuscripts/main/MANUSCRIPT.tex`, explicitly a "STUB — NO CONTENT MIGRATED". (5) 2026-08-15 prune 8c98573 deleted the stub, the spine, the Sourcebook set, chat-3 and most notes; three drafts and two chats survived. (6) 2026-08-16 AU-NORM-01..04 fixed four 0-byte manuscripts READMEs as "do not restore" and restored the definition. (7) 2026-09-05 the 7LM routing moved the survivors to `USO/l4/work/writing/` (renamed `L8/L4/work/writing/` on 2026-09-12); the last 0-byte `manuscripts/` files were deleted 2026-09-07, so no `manuscripts/` directory exists at HEAD.

Where it got to, per the records: three live drafts, two chats, one session record and the branch rules sit at L4 as "writing as performed work"; nothing is released; "nothing is built". Still pending by the records' own words: a real LaTeX migration (the master LEDGER row is stale against the tree), the prior-art search ("still unrun"), the owner's extraction of three session objects, the split-or-cite decisions, T3, Q1–Q9 and the line-52 edit. A book-structure roadmap exists only on the closed, unmerged branch origin/claude/book-structure-roadmap-k8ap82 (2026-09-13/14).

The sheet says of the three items placed there that day: "none adjudicated". No item in the directory actually carries a PARKED label; PARKED appears only in the rule text and the ladder definition.

What sits there: STATUS_LADDER.md and STATUS_AND_LABEL_DISCIPLINE.md (governance texts carried verbatim), CONTRADICTIONS.md (C1–C7, "reported and never harmonized"), PERPETUITY_QUESTION_ADJUDICATION.md (2026-08-02, "DEAD FOR NOW", with the §6.1 line-52 edit "Pending Eric's ruling"), and `autonomous-theory/`: `#autonomous(1).txt` (1,060,768 B) and `02_AutonomousTheory(1).pdf` (219,277 B, 27 pp.). The Autonomous Theory files are the one thing waiting for a specific owner's word, consistently phrased since 2026-09-05: "OWNER DECISION … Stays in orphan/ until Eric moves it" (routing plan), "leaves once the owner names its home" (harmonization §8), "they leave this repository once the owner names that work's home" (review/0.md:42), "awaiting the owner's call" (peer-1 sheet), and harmonization:125 lists "the Autonomous Theory files' home" among things "Not done, by the owner's word or pending it". The other open items are the author's calls (T3, Q1–Q9/Q9, the DEF:52 edit, the reader-agnostic divergence), "none decided anywhere in this repository".

Is anything in the catch-all a manuscript draft? Not of the Auditonomous manuscript. The live drafts are at `L8/L4/work/writing/` (two .docx, one .odt, two chat .docx); `MANUSCRIPT.tex` is a "STUB" that "does not exist at HEAD". The only draft-like object in the catch-all is `#autonomous(1).txt`, which is a draft of a different work: lines 1–635 are Markdown prose "Autonomous Theory: Post-Biological Intelligence … Autonomous Alien Theory (AAT) … Eric [name withheld] Martin - 2025", and lines 636–746 are a JSON chat export dated 2025-06-25 with embedded HTML pages and a [source text withheld from the public copy]. It contains zero occurrences of "auditonom". The PDF is "Document Version: 1.0 (Unreviewed) … Status: Speculative hypothesis awaiting peer review", printed from autonomoustheory.org on 2025-10-11. Contradiction to record: review/0.md calls the .txt "the 2025 Autonomous Theory draft"; the closed roadmap branch calls it a "chat export"; the sourcebook's L015 row calls it "CORE EXCLUSION … [source text withheld from the public copy]". All three are partly right. DISTILLATION is explicitly "not a manuscript"; its §5 says [source text withheld from the public copy] is "still unrun", while §7 (not §5) records a four-lane prior-art verification of the correspondence rows. PERPETUITY and THEME_LEDGER cite `intake/manuscript/Block_*.md` paths that no longer exist at HEAD.

# Where the Auditonomous manuscript development got to (read 2026-11-03)

**Short answer.** No chapter of the book has been written. The author's only book prose is the fifty-two-block Auditonomous Theory corpus of July 2026 (committed 2 August, last edited 4 August, pruned from `main` on 15 August); everything since is planning: a prospectus and referee report (3 August), an extraction sourcebook (6 August), a chapter-title spine (14 August), a roadmap (13 and 14 September) and twenty-seven empty chapter files (14 September). `origin/main` is still `2165144`, the PR #26 merge of 11 September 2026; the roadmap, restored corpus, chapter files and vocabulary paper exist only on the branch of draft PR #27, closed unmerged on 17 October. The roadmap's last word is "the writing not begun (S6)"; today's commit 714480d on a new beta branch does not touch the book.

## The corpus (2 to 4 August)

The Master Archive (748 lines), the 18-chapter TOC and 52 block files entered git in 5a8d533. Blocks 31, 32, 35 and 36 are 8-byte "Skipped." files, the author's own markers ("[source text withheld from the public copy]"), whose meaning was recorded twice: 3406bd1 (2 August) wrote "skipped at the outline layer"; 314ceba (4 August, titled "IEEE read") rewrote the TOC to "cut from the book" on a second ruling, THEME_LEDGER T1 noting "two successive misreadings", and stripped Block 3's header. Nothing else ever changed: the archive blob is byte-identical from 2 August to the branch and still chapter-maps the cut blocks; Blocks 44 and 46 citing cut Block 36 is flagged [ERIC]. The TOC marks six chapters "material drafted", five "core argument seeded", Ch 8 "to develop", Ch 17 "partial material drafted"; ARCH:748 names the next steps: decide the subtitle, draft Ch 8, expand six chapters.

## The planning documents

*Prospectus (3 August).* `auditonomous-08-03-26.odt` is a LibreOffice capture of a ChatGPT session: a model-written "Book Prospectus v0.1" on "Your uploaded notes", 5 parts, 20 chapters. Its only prose is a three-paragraph "Proposed opening passage"; its [source text withheld from the public copy]". Unchanged since 71f75cb (5 August), which also committed that afternoon's "Deep Research Pro Prompt v1.0", pruned and not restored.

*Referee report (3 August).* `auditonomouos-important.docx`: "Auditonomy: Adversarial Scientific Assessment and Research Blueprint", "Search date: August 3, 2026", docx generator "ChatGPT Deep Research". Its one cited upload matches the prompt (seven invariants, Roswell levels R5 to R7), not the prospectus (six invariants, R0 to R4). Verdicts: "[I] partial integrative and operational novelty"; "[source text withheld from the public copy]"; "not a completed systematic review". None of its fourteen research tasks has a follow-up; "referee blueprint" is the branch's name for it, not the file's.

*Sourcebook (6 August).* `auditnomous-main.docx` is a LibreOffice re-save of the python-docx "Auditonomous Book Material Sourcebook" v0.1, text-identical: "an extraction corpus", "not a final manuscript". It carries a 30-row coverage ledger, two "Manuscript-ready" definitions, a thesis sentence and ten items of work remaining, first "ratify the final internal definition". The set (with a zip of inputs found nowhere else in git) entered `main` in merge 077d5de on 8 August; the prune kept only this re-save and the chat volumes; the branch restored the .md, CSV ledger and JSON manifest. The chat files are "Chat History Ingestion" volumes I and II of the series, though main's sheet calls them transcripts; volume III, pruned, is restored on the branch. All three leave the λ_A definition open (CH-01).

*Spine (14 August).* `SPINE_v0.1_2026-08-14.md` (f67968b): "chapter titles only · INTERNALLY DERIVED synthesis", 42 titles under Part 0 and Parts I to VII, "the 1947/contact material (Blocks 45–52)" severed to Appendix F. Both left HEAD on 15 August; only the spine is restored, so that ruling survives at no ref tip.

*Roadmap (13 September, revised 14 September).* Branch only: "PROPOSAL · INTERNAL ONLY · INTERNALLY DERIVED ... Nothing here is adopted", written on your 13 September instruction for an "academic book for auditbonomy and first contact". Eight parts, 27 chapters, labelled [source text withheld from the public copy], none VERIFIED as a whole; 22 decisions D1 to D23, unruled except D15, "[source text withheld from the public copy]". It also logs steps S0 to S5 done that day and S6 (writing) not begun, though it counts six chapters "drafted" from the blocks. It composes six prior structures; a seventh, the author's six-chapter plan of 31 July, is unlisted. D1 sets the spine's severance against that instruction and recommends one academic book with the scenario narrative in a companion; the ledger's "scholarly only" is never cited.

*Chapter files (14 September).* `L8/L4/work/writing/book/ch01` to `ch27` (b1ec302) are 24- to 29-line headers each ending "*Not yet drafted.*"; `bibliography.md` "No entry yet", by rule; `build.sh` "Not run in the environment that wrote it (pandoc absent there)", a pandoc build, not the LaTeX migration `LEDGER.md:37` still awaits. The author's only book prose is the fifty-two-block Auditonomous Theory corpus of July 2026 (committed 2 August, last edited 4 August, pruned from `main` on 15 August); everything since is planning: a prospectus and referee report (3 August), an extraction sourcebook (6 August), a chapter-title spine (14 August), a roadmap (13 and 14 September) and twenty-seven empty chapter files (14 September). `origin/main` is still `2165144`, the PR #26 merge of 11 September 2026; the roadmap, restored corpus, chapter files and vocabulary paper exist only on the branch of draft PR #27, closed unmerged on 17 October. The roadmap's last word is "the writing not begun (S6)"; today's commit 714480d on a new beta branch does not touch the book.

## The corpus (2 to 4 August)

The Master Archive (748 lines), the 18-chapter TOC and 52 block files entered git in 5a8d533. Blocks 31, 32, 35 and 36 are 8-byte "Skipped." files, the author's own markers ("[source text withheld from the public copy]"), whose meaning was recorded twice: 3406bd1 (2 August) wrote "skipped at the outline layer"; 314ceba (4 August, titled "IEEE read") rewrote the TOC to "cut from the book" on a second ruling, THEME_LEDGER T1 noting "two successive misreadings", and stripped Block 3's header. Nothing else ever changed: the archive blob is byte-identical from 2 August to the branch and still chapter-maps the cut blocks; Blocks 44 and 46 citing cut Block 36 is flagged [ERIC]. The TOC marks six chapters "material drafted", five "core argument seeded", Ch 8 "to develop", Ch 17 "partial material drafted"; ARCH:748 names the next steps: decide the subtitle, draft Ch 8, expand six chapters.

## The planning documents

*Prospectus (3 August).* `auditonomous-08-03-26.odt` is a LibreOffice capture of a ChatGPT session: a model-written "Book Prospectus v0.1" on "Your uploaded notes", 5 parts, 20 chapters. Its only prose is a three-paragraph "Proposed opening passage"; its [source text withheld from the public copy]". Unchanged since 71f75cb (5 August), which also committed that afternoon's "Deep Research Pro Prompt v1.0", pruned and not restored.

*Referee report (3 August).* `auditonomouos-important.docx`: "Auditonomy: Adversarial Scientific Assessment and Research Blueprint", "Search date: August 3, 2026", docx generator "ChatGPT Deep Research". Its one cited upload matches the prompt (seven invariants, Roswell levels R5 to R7), not the prospectus (six invariants, R0 to R4). Verdicts: "[I] partial integrative and operational novelty"; "[source text withheld from the public copy]"; "not a completed systematic review". None of its fourteen research tasks has a follow-up; "referee blueprint" is the branch's name for it, not the file's.

*Sourcebook (6 August).* `auditnomous-main.docx` is a LibreOffice re-save of the python-docx "Auditonomous Book Material Sourcebook" v0.1, text-identical: "an extraction corpus", "not a final manuscript". It carries a 30-row coverage ledger, two "Manuscript-ready" definitions, a thesis sentence and ten items of work remaining, first "ratify the final internal definition". The set (with a zip of inputs found nowhere else in git) entered `main` in merge 077d5de on 8 August; the prune kept only this re-save and the chat volumes; the branch restored the .md, CSV ledger and JSON manifest. The chat files are "Chat History Ingestion" volumes I and II of the series, though main's sheet calls them transcripts; volume III, pruned, is restored on the branch. All three leave the λ_A definition open (CH-01).

*Spine (14 August).* `SPINE_v0.1_2026-08-14.md` (f67968b): "chapter titles only · INTERNALLY DERIVED synthesis", 42 titles under Part 0 and Parts I to VII, "the 1947/contact material (Blocks 45–52)" severed to Appendix F. An hour later the hub ledger recorded decision 5 of "Owner decisions 2026-08-14": "Book register: scholarly only ... Spine's Appendix-F severance stands." Both left HEAD on 15 August; only the spine is restored, so that ruling survives at no ref tip.

*Roadmap (13 September, revised 14 September).* Branch only: "PROPOSAL · INTERNAL ONLY · INTERNALLY DERIVED ... Nothing here is adopted", written on your 13 September instruction for an "academic book for auditbonomy and first contact". Eight parts, 27 chapters, labelled [source text withheld from the public copy], none VERIFIED as a whole; 22 decisions D1 to D23, unruled except D15, "[source text withheld from the public copy]". It also logs steps S0 to S5 done that day and S6 (writing) not begun, though it counts six chapters "drafted" from the blocks. It composes six prior structures; a seventh, the author's six-chapter plan of 31 July, is unlisted. D1 sets the spine's severance against that instruction and recommends one academic book with the scenario narrative in a companion; the ledger's "scholarly only" is never cited.

*Chapter files (14 September).* `L8/L4/work/writing/book/ch01` to `ch27` (b1ec302) are 24- to 29-line headers each ending "*Not yet drafted.*"; `bibliography.md` "No entry yet", by rule; `build.sh` "Not run in the environment that wrote it (pandoc absent there)", a pandoc build, not the LaTeX migration `LEDGER.md:37` still awaits. Next by the roadmap: you read the two papers, rule D22 and D23, an adversarial review, "[source text withheld from the public copy])".

*Vocabulary paper (14 September).* Branch only: "DRAFT of 2026-09-14 · INTERNAL ONLY ... Not adversarially reviewed. Nothing released." Its "VERIFIED" negative finding that Aud(S,F) occurs nowhere in the sourcebook is wrong (sourcebook line 116 states it in LaTeX); the roadmap's 14 September "correction" repeated the error. Its companion baseline paper sits in aybllc/autonomous PR #29, a draft closed unmerged the same minute as #27; its proposed exemplar tag "was never created".

*Embodied manuscript; the .tex stub.* "Embodied Auditonomy, LexROM, and the Cabin Model" (v0.2, 28 April 2026) entered on 30 July, was pruned, and is restored on the branch at the peer-3 binding (its parent sheet is stale).
